claims.content: To create an individual user under a user group with the mandatory Group Name, User Name, Password, and Verify Password information.

goal.raw_text: To create an individual user under a user group with the mandatory Group Name, User Name, Password, and Verify Password information.

claims.content: System Administrator
A User Group exists for the Group Name selected for the new Individual User.
The intended Individual User name does not already exist.
The System Administrator initiates creation of a new Individual User under a User Group.

trigger.raw_text: The System Administrator initiates creation of a new Individual User under a User Group.

claims.content: The system has the provision to create an Individual User under a User Group.
The system captures Group Name, User Name, Password, and Verify Password for the Individual User.
Group Name is selected from User Group.
The system requires all of the above information as mandatory entries.
The system saves the user information only if the Password and Verify Password values are equal.
The system does not allow an Individual User with an existing name.
5a. If the Password and Verify password values are not equal, the system does not save the user information.
6a. If an Individual User with an existing name is entered, the system does not allow the user to create the Individual User with existing names.
1. If the Password and Verify Password values are not equal, the system does not save the user information; the use case exits without creating the Individual User account.
2. If an Individual User with an existing name is entered, the system does not allow the user to create the Individual User with existing names; the use case exits without creating the account.

3. If any mandatory entry for the Individual User (Group Name, User Name, Password, or Verify Password) is not provided, the mandatory entry requirement is not met; the use case exits without saving the Individual User account.
The Individual User information has been saved by the system.
The saved Individual User information includes Group Name (selected from User Group), User Name, Password, and Verify Password, all of which were provided as mandatory entries.
The Password and Verify Password values for the Individual User are equal.
The Individual User has been created under a User Group and its User Name is not an existing Individual User name.
